eyebrow: A little room for what comes next
hero: Your income changes. Your savings plan can, too.
intro: Protect the essentials ahead of you. Set a little aside when there is room. Reach for your buffer when life happens.
startNote: A fictional Philippine delivery rider. No signup or personal data.
scope: This prototype uses a mock wallet and a fixed September 28, 2026 scenario. Suggestions are estimates, not guarantees.
consentIntro: Choose what this synthetic demo may use. You can withdraw your buffer even after revoking analysis consent.
transactions: Use synthetic income and spending history
transactionsNote: Estimate payment timing and everyday essentials.
balancesNote: Compare your available money with upcoming needs.
ai: Enable optional local AI plan entry
aiNote: Only the text you enter goes to the configured local model. Review every field before applying it.
overviewIntro: Your plan protects upcoming essentials before suggesting a saving.
etaUnavailable: ETA needs 30 days of positive net savings history.
roomNote: Beyond planned essentials, using your current assumptions.
suggestionNote: A choice, never an automatic debit.
noSurplus: Keep this money available for essentials.
scenariosNote: Assumed expenses, not typical emergencies or probabilities.
planTitle: What does your money need to cover?
planIntro: Review the assumptions. An omitted bill can change the suggestion.
label: Description
planSaved: Plan confirmed. Your suggestion has been recalculated.
assistantTitle: Describe it in your own words
assistantIntro: AI drafts the details. You stay in control.
assistantPlaceholder: I also need 300 pesos for school tomorrow.
aiOff: Local model not connected. Manual entry is ready below.
aiOn: Experimental local AI · drafts may contain errors
aiConsentNeeded: Enable optional AI consent in Privacy to use this feature.
reviewNote: Check amounts, dates, recurrence, income, and daily-budget inclusion. AI can invent details. Nothing has changed yet.
emergencyTitle: Your buffer is here when you need it.
emergencyIntro: Move savings back to your wallet. No explanation or penalty required in this mock demo.
paymentNote: Withdrawal moves money between accounts. Payment is a separate expense.
refillNote: Optional. No debits scheduled. Check affordability again before each future saving.
refillPaused: Recovery estimate paused. Review your income and available room first.
withdrawn: Withdrawal complete. The money is now in your wallet.
privacyIntro: Analysis consent is optional. Access to your own mock funds stays available.
deleteNote: Deletes this session, plan, consent, and derived snapshots. Pseudonymous audit metadata and simulated movement amounts remain.
confirmDelete: Confirm deletion of this demo session
auditNote: A hash chain is not tamper-proof against someone who can rewrite the entire database.
confirmReset: Confirm reset to the original synthetic balances
depositDone: Deposit confirmed. Your buffer has grown.
consentRequired: Review consent to see planning estimates.
footer: Mock wallet · Synthetic history · English prototype · No validated real-world impact
